verbose_flag.description: Verbosity flag. Use '-v' to display names, empty string for quiet.

name_flag.description: Restore original file name if present. Use '--no-name' to disable. Default is --name for portability, though -n is default on UNIX.

checksum_flag.description: Checksum type. '--crc32' or '--no-checksum'. Note: checksum is always stored at levels -7, -8, -9.
